entries.title: Finite quantum kinematics
entries.motivation: States are probabilities on observables of a finite quantum system. This supplies no spacetime or clock.

entries.title: Subsystems and a diagonal preparation
entries.motivation: Distinguishable registers let us ask which geometric information a state can determine. A chosen factorization supplies subsystem labels without a spatial embedding.

entries.title: Positive mutual information and walk distance
entries.motivation: The support rule makes a purely relational inference to adjacency. Unit edge costs are fixed by the rule.

entries.title: Clock shift and system map
entries.motivation: A stationary history is conditioned on a selected clock and joint shift. Clock labels and iterates are mathematical.

entries.title: Trace-preserving local intervention
entries.motivation: The stochastic diagonal case needs column normalization. Access to the specified intervention is extra structure.

entries.title: Selected interval and boost parameters
entries.motivation: The interval is an input of the conditional invariant calculation. It cannot support a foundational derivation of itself.

entries.title: Normalized diagonal law
entries.motivation: Nonnegative weights sum to one in a specified orthonormal basis.

entries.title: Incident token
entries.motivation: A token is shared by its two endpoints wherever the graph has an edge.

entries.title: Reachable reversible path costs
entries.motivation: Zero-length, reversal and concatenation laws capture walks in a connected component.

entries.title: Shifted clock history
entries.motivation: A shift combines the inverse clock permutation and a system map.

entries.title: Zero set of a scalar-valued map
entries.motivation: Zero sets ignore multiplication by nonzero scalars.

entries.title: Path and triangle
entries.motivation: At the same label count the two graphs disagree about completeness.
